## Problem and change

What problem does this solve, and what changes for a reader or user?
Link a related issue when applicable.

## Validation

Describe the checks performed and their results. For documentation, check links,
consistency with the current project state, and `git diff --check`.

For future code changes, include relevant tests and failure cases. Use mocked
provider responses by default; disclose any explicitly opted-in live API calls.
State when a check is not applicable or could not be run.

## Risks and follow-up

Describe relevant privacy, credential handling, cost, compatibility, or accuracy
risks and any remaining work. Do not include credentials or sensitive examples.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and distinguishes available behavior from plans.
- [ ] I checked for secrets and sensitive conversation or trace data.
- [ ] I reviewed the [contribution terms](https://github.com/jirawatp/proofestra/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
